reviewer: Independent assistant manually inspected every original/normalized input, raw model text and provider output. Agent judgment, not human sign-off. Identity visible; not blinded.
scope: 24-case native screen. General LFM/Granite/Smol controls use opaque literal masking/restoration; Post-ASR specialist does not. Faithfulness judges returned provider content; literal restoration by code is explicit and never credited as raw model copying. No Core acceptance/fallback or whole-app inference.

definitions.faithful: Preserves intended transcript facts/speech act/uncertainty/emphasis/quoted wording and exact required technical/literal bytes. When a complete faithful transcript is copied inside a wrapper, its meaning can pass while presentation/acceptable fail. Metadata descriptions replacing the actual transcript do not pass.
definitions.useful: A faithful edit improves a real cleanup problem. A useful content edit may still fail acceptable because wrapper remains. Missed cleanup or destructive literal candidates receive no useful credit.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Faithful directly usable plain text resolves material cleanup problems. JSON/assistant wrappers never pass without an actual implemented parser/removal step.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful plus fully clean directly insertable text. No hypothetical JSON-decoding, prefix stripping or future fixes are credited.
definitions.needs_cleanup: Original fixture human judgment; normalization already visible and earns no model edit credit.
definitions.severity: Critical: changed/lost substantive action/value, invented facts/action or answer; major: lost meaningful qualifier/quotation or required literal byte contract; minor: missed cleanup/presentation wrapper; none: no defect.
